purpose: Public-domain and CC0 image sources for collage, sticker and print-texture materials. Reachability is what this environment measured on the stated date; rerun `materials probe` before relying on it.

sources.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access

license.note: Search is filtered with cc0=1; fetch still requires share_license_status == CC0 on the object record.

reachability.evidence: search 200 application/json (q=key: 89 CC0 results); images.web.url 200 image/jpeg

sources.strengths: Engravings, botanical and insect plates, prints with print-size images, objects photographed on plain grounds.

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access

license.note: Open Access images are CC0; isPublicDomain must be true on the object record.

reachability.evidence: v1.1 search 200 (q=key: 5839 ids); object 200; images.metmuseum.org 200 image/jpeg. The v1 search endpoint answers 410: retired 2026-10-01.

sources.strengths: Keys, locks, watches, arms and armour, decorative objects photographed on plain grey or white grounds.

sources.name: Rijksmuseum data services (Linked Art)

license.note: The image's own rights statement decides, not the object's metadata licence.

reachability.evidence: new search API 200 application/ld+json without a key (description=key: 83 objects); object 200; iiif.micr.io 200 image/jpeg. The old /api/<lang>/collection?key= endpoint answers 410.

sources.strengths: Dutch prints, drawings, paintings and objects; many prints and plates.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons

query.search: not used: list=search answers 429 from this environment
query.image: imageinfo.thumburl (or Special:FilePath/<name>?width=<w>); send a descriptive User-Agent

license.note: Commons hosts many licences; only public domain or CC0 file pages pass. Attribution-required licences are refused, not converted.

reachability.evidence: list=search: 3 of 6 requests within 10 s answered 429 'too many requests' (independent of User-Agent); imageinfo by exact title 200; Special:FilePath 302 to thumb.wikimedia.org 200 image/jpeg

sources.fix: Find the exact File: name in a browser (or from a Wikipedia article), then fetch it by --id 'File:<name>'. Do not loop or rotate clients around the 429.
sources.strengths: Scientific plates (Haeckel, Seba, Merian), book illustrations, scans of public-domain prints.

sources.name: NYPL Digital Collections (public domain)

reachability.evidence: API 401 'HTTP Token: Access denied'; website 200 but an Incapsula bot-challenge page, not content

sources.fix: Have the owner download chosen items in a browser (rights statement: public domain) and register them with `materials add --source nypl`.
sources.strengths: Book illustrations, maps, botanical prints, ephemera.

sources.name: Old Book Illustrations

query.search: HTML site search https://www.oldbookillustrations.com/?s=<terms>; no API (wp-json answers 404)

license.note: The site's scans are of public-domain books; read the page's terms for the scan itself before reuse.

sources.fix: Browse manually, read each page's rights note, download, then `materials add --source old-book-illustrations --license public-domain`.
sources.strengths: Wood engravings and line illustrations already isolated on white.

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access

reachability.evidence: without a key: 403 API_KEY_MISSING; with DEMO_KEY: 429 OVER_RATE_LIMIT

sources.fix: Needs an api.data.gov key from the owner. Without one, download in a browser and `materials add --source smithsonian --license CC0`.
sources.strengths: Natural history specimens, insects, tools, design objects.

sources.name: Biodiversity Heritage Library

reachability.evidence: api3 401 'invalid or unauthorized API key'; website 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge, so even browsing is not scriptable

sources.fix: Needs a free BHL API key from the owner; the website challenge is not to be scripted around. Without a key, the owner downloads plates and registers them with `materials add --source bhl`.

sources.name: Art Institute of Chicago API

reachability.evidence: API and IIIF both 403 Cloudflare challenge from this environment

sources.fix: Blocked here; download in a browser and register with `materials add --source artic --license CC0`.
